C0192.title: How Fake Viewers, Followers, and Bots Are Used in Livestreams: Operational Methods and Platform Logic
C0192.summary: The article reveals how livestreams on Douyin and Kuaishou inflate viewer counts using software or scripts that simulate user interactions, generating fake online numbers and engagement data. The goal is to leverage herd mentality to attract real users, capture organic platform traffic, and help new streamers build psychological confidence, indirectly boosting conversion potential.
